中国业余无线电全国性组织，负责题库与考试相关工作。: The national amateur radio organisation of China, responsible for the question bank and exam work.
中国大陆主要位于 CQ 23、24 区，ITU 42–44 区。: Mainland China is mainly in CQ zones 23 and 24 and ITU zones 42–44.
代表全球业余无线电爱好者，协调国际事务与频段。: Represents amateur radio operators worldwide and coordinates international affairs and bands.
全球划分为 40 个 CQ 分区，是 WAZ（Worked All Zones，: The world is divided into 40 CQ zones, the basis of the WAZ (Worked All Zones) award and of contests.
全球划分为 90 个 ITU 分区，用于呼号与频率协调。: The world is divided into 90 ITU zones, used for callsign and frequency coordination.
日本业余组织，管理 JARL 奖状与活动。: The Japanese amateur organisation, administering JARL awards and events.
美国最大业余组织，颁发 DXCC 等奖状、出版刊物。: The largest amateur organisation in the USA; issues awards such as DXCC and publishes periodicals.
联合国下属机构，统一全球无线电频谱与呼号前缀分配。: A United Nations agency that unifies the global radio spectrum and the allocation of callsign prefixes.
英国业余组织，颁发 IOTA 奖状。: The British amateur organisation, which issues the IOTA award.
